user.title: Add a YouTube TV
user.description: Choose how to link this TV.

tv_code.title: Enter the YouTube TV code
tv_code.description: On the TV you want to link, open the YouTube app, go to **Settings → Link with TV code**, and enter the 12-digit code shown on the TV.

existing_screen_id.title: Enter an existing screen ID
existing_screen_id.description: Copy this TV's `screen_id` from the `devices` list in your iSponsorBlockTV `config.json`. You can also copy the TV's `name`.

screen_id_rejected.title: Screen ID rejected
screen_id_rejected.description: YouTube rejected this screen ID. Get a fresh TV code from the YouTube app, or try another saved screen ID.

discovery_confirm.title: Discovered a YouTube TV
discovery_confirm.description: Home Assistant found **{name}** on your network. Continue to check its YouTube pairing.

confirm.title: Confirm the matched TV
confirm.description: The YouTube pairing check succeeded. Submit to add **{name}**.

name.title: Name the matched TV
name.description: YouTube verified the pairing. Enter a name for this TV.

repair_confirm.title: Confirm the original TV
repair_confirm.description: The new code matched a different screen ID. Confirm that you got this code from the same TV you added as **{name}**.

data.same_tv: I got this code from the original TV

error.cannot_connect: YouTube could not verify the pairing right now. Try again.
error.invalid_code: The TV code is invalid or expired. Enter the current 12-digit code shown on the TV.
error.name_required: Enter a name for this TV.
error.confirm_original_tv: Confirm the code came from the original TV to continue.

abort.no_youtube_screen: The TV did not expose a YouTube screen ID. You can add it with a TV code.

data_description.skip_categories: Clear all categories to disable SponsorBlock skipping on this TV.
data_description.offset: Use a positive value to send the seek command earlier.
data_description.disturb_short_videos: Interrupt all videos shorter than the threshold, including regular videos. Also send Back after reconnecting from a recent TV-initiated user disconnect.
data_description.short_video_duration_threshold: Compare this threshold with the duration reported by the YouTube app.

data.join_name: Name shown in the YouTube app
data.channel_whitelist: Channels to exclude from SponsorBlock skipping

data_description.channel_whitelist: Enter the YouTube channel ID for each channel you want to exclude. Requires a YouTube Data API key.

error.api_key_required: Enter a YouTube Data API key to exclude channels.
error.invalid_short_video_duration_threshold: Enter a finite duration in seconds.
error.invalid_sponsorblock_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL for the SponsorBlock API.
